title: The Geometry of Language Model Logits: Generic Structure and Learned Departures
abstract: arXiv:2610.18520v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive language models produce, at every prediction step, a vocabulary-sized logit vector whose structure determines the conditional next-token distribution. We empirically identify that the ordered vocabulary-head logits follow a remarkably consistent log-linear relation   \[ z_{(r)} \approx \mu - \alpha \log r. \] across prediction contexts, architectures, and scales, emerging progressively during pretraining. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of the logit geometry underlying the distributional assumptions used in the prior decoding work. While controlled order-statistic baselines spanning bounded, light-tailed, and heavier-tailed distributions can largely explain the observed log-linear geometry, they do not explain the systematic shift in the slope $\alpha$: trained language models exhibit $\alpha \approx 1.4$--$1.7$, sitting well above the initialization baseline ($\alpha \approx 0.2$) . translated_title: 语言模型Logits的几何结构：通用结构与习得的偏离
translated_abstract: 自回归语言模型在每一步预测时都会产生一个词表大小的logit向量，其结构决定了条件性的下一个词元分布。我们通过实证研究发现，经过排序的词表头部logits在不同的预测上下文、架构和模型规模下都遵循一个高度一致的对数线性关系：z₍ᵣ₎ ≈ μ - α log r，且这一关系在预训练过程中逐渐显现。据我们所知，这是首次对先前解码工作中所用分布假设背后的logit几何结构进行系统性分析。虽然涵盖有界分布、轻尾分布和重尾分布的受控顺序统计基线在很大程度上能够解释所观察到的对数线性几何结构，但它们无法解释斜率α的系统性偏移：训练后的语言模型呈现出α ≈ 1.4–1.7，远高于初始化基线（α ≈ 0.2）。此外，α……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文首次系统分析了语言模型logits的几何结构，发现排序后的logits在不同上下文、架构和规模下普遍遵循对数线性关系z₍ᵣ₎ ≈ μ - α log r，且训练后的模型斜率α（约1.4–1.7）显著偏离初始化基线（约0.2），揭示了预训练使模型习得了超越通用顺序统计结构的独特logit分布特性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first systematic analysis of language model logit geometry, showing that ordered logits consistently follow a log-linear relation z₍ᵣ₎ ≈ μ - α log r across contexts, architectures, and scales, with trained models exhibiting slopes (α ≈ 1.4–1.7) that systematically depart from initialization baselines (α ≈ 0.2), revealing learned departures from generic order-statistic structure.
